text:
maria: Quick heads-up — Datadog demo studio slot confirmed for Thursday 11:00 PT. Need a short run-through of telemetry + a slimming down of the dashboard tiles we show. Who can own the obs checklist?
aj: I can own the tech checklist. Will validate OTLP export, trace sampling, and the APM spans we surface. Can anyone confirm we can export to the partner sandbox?
maria: Thanks aj. Samir, can SI access the sandbox cluster still? We need to invite one customer for the live walkthrough.
samir: Yes, SI still has access. I'll invite Jenna from Acme and ask them to share a small tracing payload. Also will prep a short script for the demo flow.
jen: I'll handle the marketing/press side — need the final slide text and approved logos by Wed EOD. Also we should decide: public announcement or partner-only demo?
maria: Partner-only for this run. We want to validate dashboards & alerting behavior.
aj: Technical checklist draft below — folks please ack or add: 
```
- verify OTLP endpoint reachable from demo sandbox
- set trace.sampling.rate = 0.25 for demo tenant
- enable dd-proxy exporter with API key scoped to sandbox
- prewarm trace index with sample long-tail request (>=5s)
- attach `trace_id` to model inference logs
```
aj: For the OTLP exporter we used this in the sandbox: 
```
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_SANDBOX_DD_KEY}
    site: datadoghq.com
service:
  name: redwood-demo
```
maria: Perfect. Can someone add a tiny dashboard with these tiles: 1) trace waterfall for request path, 2) tail-latency histogram by model, 3) error count (5xx + model rate-limit), 4) tokens/sec. Keep each tile < 4 metrics.
jen: I'll produce the slide pack and a short script: 3 mins product intro, 5 mins demo, 7 mins Q&A. Also will include privacy blurb for using customer traces.
samir: I'll coordinate the SI runbook and send a short runbook doc link: https://docs.redwood.example/partnerships/dd-demo-runbook (placeholder)
maria: Timeline:
- Tue EOD: tech checklist sign-off (aj)
- Wed EOD: slide pack + logos (jen)
- Thu 09:30 PT: full dry-run with SI + Acme (all)
- Thu 11:00 PT: live demo
aj: One ask — can eng-observability enable a low-rate synthetic generator on the sandbox cluster to populate traces? That helps stabilize waterfall views.
maria: Good call. @obs-bot can you spin up the generator and report back? :pray:
obs-bot: scheduled task created — synthetic-trace-gen for demo-sandbox will run Wed 08:00 PT. I will post completion in this thread. :robot_face: 
aj: Acked. Also please ensure the model-serving logs include `trace_id` header so we can link spans -> inference tokens.
samir: Noted, I'll add to runbook.
jen: Do we need to coordinate with compliance for customer trace sharing? I can ping security to confirm redaction policy.
maria: Yes do that today. Add required redaction checklist to runbook: remove PII, mask prompt content, keep model metrics only.
aj: Last bit: if Datadog rate-limits during demo we should fallback to a local lightweight dashboard (Grafana snapshot). I'll add a quick snapshot script to the runbook.
maria: Great — let's iterate. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. Thanks all! :tada:
